repaired_findings.finding: The first validator revision trusted package-declared live identities instead of resolving Git refs and PR state independently. Live validation now resolves and compares remote branch, tree, evidence bytes and draft/unmerged PR state.
Audit and manifest paths were not closed by the package allowlist. They are now explicit allowed paths and semantic rules are independently checked.

Package inventory was initially top-level only and live validation did not enumerate the remote subtree. Local validation now rejects subdirectories and recursively compares exact inventory; live validation uses recursive git tree enumeration and byte hashes every admitted file.
